info.title: 🏛️ Tender Management Platform & GeM ML Intelligence Backend — Complete API Specification
info.description: Comprehensive consolidated OpenAPI 3.1 REST API specification for the entire backend ecosystem. Covers Unified Auth, Bidder Self-Service & Documents, Bidder Tender Chatbot AI, Officer DigiLocker Verification, Tender Management, Node AI RAG Microservice, and the 13-Endpoint GeM ML Microservice (v2.0.0).

servers.description: Production Python GeM ML Microservice (Azure VM)

tags.name: 1. Unified Authentication Gateway
tags.description: Cross-role login, user profile resolution, and unified registration.

tags.name: 2. Bidder Authentication & Management
tags.description: Bidder sign-up (with companyName sync), government registry pre-validation, OTP verification, login, password reset, and profile CRUD.

tags.name: 3. Bidder Tender Chatbot AI
tags.description: Bidder tender RAG chatbot integration. Securely query tender requirements, scope, criteria, and terms using Gemini LLM and pgvector embeddings.

tags.name: 4. Bidder Compliance Documents & AI Intelligence
tags.description: Document ingestion to Cloudinary, pyHanko digital signature verification, pyzbar QR scanning, CIS self-check, and autonomous GFR 173(i) audits.

tags.name: 5. Officer Authentication & DigiLocker Identity
tags.description: Officer onboarding, MeriPehchaan/DigiLocker OAuth simulation, government identity validation, OTP verification, and profile management.

tags.name: 6. Officer Tender Management & Bidder Comparison
tags.description: Parallel tender ingestion (Cloudinary + Python ML + Node RAG), metadata retrieval, and AI multi-bidder comparative evaluation.

tags.name: 7. Node AI RAG & Gemini Chatbot Gateway
tags.description: Semantic search in pgvector, tender/bidder document chunking & vectorization, and Gemini 1.5 Pro inference with source citations.

tags.name: 8. GeM ML Microservice v2.0.0 Endpoints
tags.description: 13 Production ML Endpoints: Unified health, taxonomy, single intake, batch upload audit, dossier synthesis, card tampering, live GSTIN verification, and retraining.
